definitions.rmse_euclid: ||mean_i S_i - y||_2 (eq. 12 as printed) = sqrt(48) x rmse_rootmean
definitions.es_split: eq. 14 as written: mean_{i<=N/2} ||S_i - y|| - 0.5 mean_{i<=N/2} ||S_i - S_{N/2+i}||
definitions.vg_p05_ordered: eq. 16, p = 0.5, sum over all ORDERED pairs (h, h'); h = h' terms are 0
definitions.vg_p05_unordered: same over h < h' only = exactly half of the ordered value

paper_fig4_source: spec section 3 (approximate medians read off the boxplots); 'paper_independent_reading' = my own reading of the upscaled page image

rmse_13pct.definition: RMSE = root-mean over the 48 half-hours of (mean of the 200 samples - observation), per cluster-day; relative differences (CVAE - GAM)/CVAE and (CVAE - GAM)/GAM. The Euclidean RMSE is sqrt(48) times larger per day, so every ratio is identical for it.

pooled_rms_over_cluster_days.note: sqrt(mean over cluster-days of RMSE^2) = RMSE pooled over all half-hours

v1_correct_u.description: correct ES, full U-statistic over all pairs

v2_sq_spread.description: spread term with the squared Euclidean norm

v5_minmax_scaled.description: correct split ES on min-max scaled data (cluster train min/max)

v6_eq14_typo_literal.description: eq. 14 typo literally: second sum over n with summand indexed by the leftover i = N/2

v7_first_term_all_2overN.description: first sum over all N samples with factor 2/N (= 2 E||S-y||), correct spread

v8_first_term_over_N.description: first sum over N/2 samples divided by N (= 0.5 E||S-y||), correct spread

v9_euclid_rmse.description: ||mean_i S_i - y|| (limit of any ES for a deterministic generator)

v10_sorted_pairs.description: split estimator after sorting the samples independently per half-hour

v11_l1_norm.description: correct split ES with the L1 norm

v12_rootmean_norm.description: correct split ES with the root-mean norm (Euclidean / sqrt(H))

v13_obs_next_day.description: correct split ES against the NEXT day's observation (misaligned by +1 day)

v14_obs_prev_day.description: correct split ES against the PREVIOUS day's observation (misaligned by -1 day)

es_level_analysis.note: For a generator with (almost) no spread every energy-score estimator equals ||mean - y|| = sqrt(48) x root-mean RMSE. The paper's CVAE samples have too little variance by its own account, so its ES should follow its RMSE panel (cluster order 3 > 1 > 0 > 2); the paper's ES panel has the order 2 > 0 > 1 > 3, which is the order of the clusters' mean consumption.

cvae_consecutive_halfhours_very_correlat.note: holds = the CVAE's generated variation is more strongly lag-1 correlated than the actual deviations of the observations from either generator's mean, in every cluster. The residual w.r.t. the CVAE mean contains the CVAE's own smooth bias, hence its higher lag-1 value.

gam_erratic.note: GAM noise correlation = empirical residual correlation by construction; its erratic look comes from the noise amplitude, not from weaker correlation

real_behaviour_in_between.note: variance: spread/skill CVAE < 1 < GAM; roughness: samples/observed CVAE < 1 < GAM; lag-1: observed residual correlation strictly between the two generators' across-sample values

definitions.spread_skill.ratio_calibrated: sqrt(mean per-slot sample variance) / RMSE of the sample mean x sqrt((N+1)/N); 1 = calibrated, <1 under-, >1 over-dispersed
definitions.coverage_centralXX: share of (day, half-hour) observations inside the central XX% sample interval
definitions.pit: rank PIT (#{S_i < y} + 0.5 + 0.5 ties)/(N+1); calibrated: mean 0.5, var 1/12, 10% in the two 5% tails; U-shape (var > 1/12) = under-dispersion, hump (var < 1/12) = over-dispersion
definitions.roughness: mean |x_{h+1} - x_h| over the 47 within-day steps
definitions.lag1.across_samples_mean_over_day_slot: mean over (day, h) of corr over samples of (S_h, S_h+1)
definitions.lag1.noise_pooled: pooled lag-1 corr of S_i - mean_i S_i (generated deviations)
definitions.lag1.residual_pooled: pooled lag-1 corr of y - mean_i S_i (actual deviations from the generator's mean); the target for the generated deviations
definitions.lag1.profile_demeaned_*: pooled lag-1 autocorrelation of whole profiles after removing each profile's daily mean (samples vs observations)

conclusions.rmse: Fig. 4 RMSE matches the root-mean over the 48 half-hours (mean ratio ours/paper CVAE 1.01, GAM 0.98); eq. 12's Euclidean norm would be 7.0x / 6.8x the paper's values.
conclusions.variogram: Variogram (p = 0.5) over all ordered pairs: mean ratio ours/paper CVAE 0.93, GAM 0.99; unordered pairs would halve it (0.46 / 0.50).
conclusions.energy_score: Energy score (eq. 14, correct): ratio ours/paper CVAE 0.63-1.25, GAM 0.39-0.70. Variants with all 8 cells within 10% of the paper: none; closest: ['v2_sq_spread', 'v3_quarter_spread'].
conclusions.es_claim: CVAE energy score lower than GAM's (correct formula) in 0 of 4 clusters (median ratio CVAE/GAM 1.58-1.83).
conclusions.rmse_13pct: RMSE difference CVAE vs GAM: median-based 23.1% (rel. to CVAE) / 30.0% (rel. to GAM); readings within 2 pp of 13%: none.
